title: Sarvam AI Releases Saaras V4: A Speech-to-Text Model for All 22 Indian Languages and Global English
summary: Sarvam AI's Saaras V4 is a speech-to-text model covering all 22 Indian languages plus global English. It pairs an audio encoder with a 3B hybrid state-space decoder. It adds keyterm prompting for up to 50 terms, 5 output modes from 1 model, and streaming with first-token latency under 150 ms. It is available today through Sarvam's API at ₹30 per hour. The post Sarvam AI Releases Saaras V4: A Speech-to-Text Model for All 22 Indian Languages and Global English appeared first on MarkTechPost. ]]>
